definitions.explanation: A collective term for various incidental expenses or costs that arise in addition to the main expenditure. Common in business, construction, and real estate contexts.

examples.japanese: {諸経費|しょけいひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別途|べっと}→別途：11881_betto⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Miscellaneous expenses will be charged separately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見積|みつも}り→見積り：04699_mitsumori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{材料費|ざいりょうひ}→材料費：11512_zairyouhi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{諸経費|しょけいひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれています→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: The estimate includes material costs and miscellaneous expenses.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧、⟦{敷金|しききん}→敷金：06079_shikikin⟧や⟦{礼金|れいきん}→礼金：06080_reikin⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{諸経費|しょけいひ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧おか⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: In addition to moving costs, you need to account for miscellaneous expenses like security deposits and key money.

notes:
USAGE:
{諸経費|しょけいひ} is a business and financial term. ⟦{諸|しょ}→諸〜：03956_sho⟧ means "various" and ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧ means "expenses." It covers all the incidental costs that don't fall into a specific main category.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諸経費|しょけいひ}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ (including miscellaneous expenses)
- {諸経費|しょけいひ}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (miscellaneous expenses not included)
- {諸経費|しょけいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧ (to include miscellaneous expenses)
- {諸経費|しょけいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{引|ひ}く→差し引く：06701_sashihiku⟧ (to deduct miscellaneous expenses)
